title: 'You're Not Human': Andre Russell Reveals 'Superhuman' KKR Game No One Talks About | Cricket News - News18
text: There are countless unforgettable Andre Russell moments that Kolkata Knight Riders fans will cherish forever. But what about the one memory Russell himself holds closest? In a candid chat with Cricbuzz , the former KKR powerhouse — who stunned fans by retiring from the IPL after being released ahead of the 2026 auction — revealed the performance he believes is his most underrated. Though he’s stepped away from playing, Russell isn’t done with KKR; he’ll continue with the franchise as part of the support staff. When asked to recall a lesser-discussed highlight of his career, Russell instantly pointed to a wild, almost unbelievable episode. “I remember missing a flight once, maybe in 2016," he said. “Because of that, I had to stay in Miami for a day or two before catching the next one. I got to India in the morning on the day of a home game in Kolkata. I think it was a day match. I landed, went straight to the hotel, chilled for a couple of hours… maybe slept for one. “I went to the team meeting, and everyone kept asking, ‘Are you sure you want to play? After such a long flight? You must be jet-lagged.’ But I told them, ‘Yeah, I’m good.’" Good was an understatement. Russell turned up and delivered a monster all-round performance — three wickets and over 60 runs — transforming his jet lag into jet fuel. “Everyone was saying, ‘Yo, you’re different… you’re not human,’" he laughed. “Anyone else would’ve been mentally drained. For me, it was special — a game no one really talks about. It meant a lot because I was committed to being out there, and honestly, I also felt a little guilty for missing the flight." Well, no wonder Russell has been hired to the franchise’s coaching staff as ‘power coach’. Who else but him, right?
